Class SimpleFSADebugContext<T>

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.fsa.SimpleFSADebugContext<T>
public class SimpleFSADebugContext<T> extends Object
Class for executing a SimleFSA in a step-by-step manner for the purpose of debugging.
